2608.11802.title: Towards Model-based Run-time Cybersecurity: On Control-Flow Anomaly Detection, Attack Identification, and Hardware Monitoring
2608.11802.paper_summary: Methods to increase the resilience of systems to cyber-attacks become increasingly important. Control-flow monitoring provides a principled basis to ensure integrity and detect possible anomalies at run-time. Once anomalies have been detected, so-called attack trees can be used to identify possible types of attacks. However, this approach is vulnerable to camouflage, by which attackers try to evade detection (and correct identification) by deliberately manipulating also the system's observed control flow. In this paper, we outline a model-based approach that provides more robust intrusion detection and attack identification through an architecture that combines software- with hardware-based monitoring. In this approach, software-level observation indicates suspicious activities, while hardware-level monitoring checks them separately in more detail, making it much harder for attacks to camouflage themselves and go undetected. We illustrate the approach with an authentication-service example that captures a realistic failure mode: a software-level observer sees an anomalous but apparently harmless control-flow deviation, maps it to a benign root cause in an attack tree, but misses the true intrusion. A second, independent hardware control-flow monitor observes the actual transition sequence and thereby changes the attack-tree diagnosis from a low-severity configuration or maintenance issue to a high-confidence code-injection or control-flow hijack. In this scenario, the proposed combination of control-flow anomaly detection, attack-tree based intrusion identification, and hardware-based monitoring can improve not only anomaly detection, but also the diagnostic precision of attack-tree-based cyber-attack identification.
2608.11802.paper_summary_zh: 增加系統對網路攻擊的韌性的方法變得越來越重要。控制流監控提供了一個原則性基礎，以確保完整性並在運行時檢測可能的異常。一旦檢測到異常，所謂的攻擊樹可以用來識別可能的攻擊類型。然而，這種方法容易受到偽裝的影響，攻擊者試圖通過故意操縱系統觀察到的控制流來逃避檢測（和正確識別）。在本文中，我們概述了一種基於模型的方法，通過結合軟體與硬體監控的架構，提供更強健的入侵檢測和攻擊識別。在這種方法中，軟體層級的觀察指示可疑活動，而硬體層級的監控則以更詳細的方式單獨檢查這些活動，使攻擊者更難偽裝自己並不被檢測到。我們用一個身份驗證服務的例子來說明這種方法，該例子捕捉了一個現實的故障模式：軟體層級的觀察者看到一個異常但看似無害的控制流偏差，將其映射到攻擊樹中的一個良性根本原因，但卻錯過了真正的入侵。第二個獨立的硬體控制流監控器觀察到實際的轉換序列，從而將攻擊樹的診斷從低嚴重性的配置或維護問題轉變為高信心的代碼注入或控制流劫持。在這種情況下，所提出的控制流異常檢測、基於攻擊樹的入侵識別以及硬體監控的組合不僅可以改善異常檢測，還可以提高基於攻擊樹的網路攻擊識別的診斷精度。
